source_limitations: Oxford 3000 CEFR PDF word/POS levels are directly observed but not exact-sense CEFR approvals. Four Oxford dictionary pages are editorial sense leads; topic tags must not be mistaken for CEFR sense labels. No independent human approval, final audio listening, physical iPhone testing, hosting measurement or deployment. Frozen shortlist unchanged.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Actions taken to keep someone or something safe.
shortlist_snapshot.myanmar_meaning: ကာကွယ်မှု၊ အကာအကွယ်ပေးခြင်း
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The workers need protection from loud noise.

records.editorial_risk: Draft concerns protection from loud noise, not insurance, trade protection, or criminal extortion. Confirm uncountable protective action rather than a protective object.

dictionary_sense_lead.editorial_interpretation: Oxford distinguishes protection as an uncountable act/state from a countable protective thing, insurance, trade and criminal senses.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: The amount of a product or service that people want to buy.
